name: Sensei to Watashi no Valentine Jijou
original_name: 先生と私のバレンタイン事情
source:
She's going out with her teacher, but they haven't really been doing anything that would make them look like a couple...
This year, on Valentine's Day, Anzu's going to do her best to get closer to him...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/19535]Freem![/url]]
translation:
明明在和老师交往，却还没怎么做过情侣会做的事……
今年情人节，あんず为了拉近与他的距离，决定好好努力一番……

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/19535]Freem![/url]]
